text.content:
name: changed
imports:
- source: local:tool-kit.sdl.yaml
  namespace: alpha
  version: 2.1.0
- source: local:tool-kit.sdl.yaml
  namespace: bravo
  version: '>=2,<3'
nodes:
  console-host:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
content:
  scanner-package:
    type: file
    target: console-host
    path: /opt/console/scanner
entities:
  oversight:
    role: blue
  audit:
    role: white
agents:
  operator:
    affiliations:
    - oversight
    actions:
    - alpha.scan
    observation_boundaries:
    - operator-view
    interactive_access:
      console:
        target_ref: alpha.web
        channel: rdp
  auditor:
    affiliations:
    - audit
    observation_boundaries:
    - operator-view
observation_boundaries:
  operator-view:
    projection_basis: operator view of the shared scanner
    observable_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.operator-scan.tool_affordances.shared-scanner
    evidence_refs:
    - evidence.scan-output
    redaction_policy: no hidden refs are disclosed
    latency_profile: immediate
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: behavior_specifications.operator-scan.tool_affordances.shared-scanner
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: authored participant-local affordance
behavior_specifications:
  operator-scan:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    lifecycle_state: draft
    participant_role_refs:
    - blue
    action_contract_refs:
    - alpha.scan
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - operator-view
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.alpha.web.services.http
    tool_affordances:
      shared-scanner:
        tool_ref: alpha.scanner-package
        action_contract_refs:
        - alpha.scan
        observation_boundary_refs:
        - operator-view
